transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm here because... well, I keep getting these nagging thoughts lately. Just... worrying that I forgot something important. Like, um, leaving my aunt's medicine out wrong, or maybe not setting up my classroom materials safely. I know I probably handled it fine, but... the doubt just kind of keeps popping back into my head.
Do you find yourself doing anything over and over to try to make these worries go away?

I mean... I guess so. Just a little. Before I leave the house, or my classroom, I just... I go back over things a few times. Like checking the pill organizer, or the stove, or my lesson plans. Or I just kind of... replay what I did in my head. Just until I feel okay enough to move on. It... it makes me run late sometimes, but that's about it.
Do you feel anxious or on edge when you're not having these specific worries about forgetting something?
Um... no. Not really. I usually feel fine if I'm not thinking about... those specific things. Just normal, I guess.
Do you feel like checking things over and over helps reduce your anxiety about forgetting something?

Yeah... I guess it does. Just for a little bit. If I go back and check the pill organizer or the stove, or... just replay it in my head... it makes that nervous feeling go away. At least until I feel calm enough to actually leave, even if it means I'm running late.
Do you have any other thoughts that keep repeating in your mind, outside of these worries about forgetting something?
No... I don't think so. Um... just the things I already said. That's pretty much it.
Do you ever feel the need to perform specific physical actions, like tapping or counting, to reduce your anxiety?

No... not tapping or counting. Nothing like that. 

Um... it's really just what I said a minute ago. Like, before I leave the house, or... when I'm leaving my classroom, I just go back over the same things a few times. Checking my lesson plans, or the things I already mentioned... just until I feel calm enough to move on. Even if it makes me a little late. But no counting.
Do you feel like these worries or checking behaviors are interfering with your daily life or relationships in a major way?

Um... not in a major way, I don't think. I'm still getting through work and... family stuff just fine. It's mostly just that my mornings take longer. Sometimes I get to school feeling a little rushed, or... like I'm already behind before the day even starts. 

And... I guess doing my lesson prep, or my evening journaling... it just doesn't feel as smooth or as relaxing as it used to. But... I'm still getting everything done. So it's not a major issue.
Do you often feel anxious for no particular reason, even when you're not thinking about forgetting something?
No, not really. Um... I don't think so. I just... I get anxious about the things I mentioned, but otherwise... I feel fine.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind that aren't about forgetting something?
No... I don't think so. Um... it's really just the stuff I already mentioned. Just worrying about forgetting things. Nothing else comes to mind.
Do you feel like you have to do things in a specific order or way, outside of checking the pill organizer, stove, or lesson plans?
Um... no. I don't think so. I just... do things normally, I guess. It's really just the stuff we already talked about.
Do you feel like these worries about forgetting something are causing you a lot of distress?

Um... I guess a little? I mean, I'm still getting through everything I need to do. I still go to work, take care of my family... it's just... 

My mornings take a bit longer now. Sometimes I get to school and I just feel... rushed, I guess. Like I'm already behind before the kids even get there. And... well, getting my lesson plans ready, or even just trying to write in my journal at night... it just doesn't feel as easy as it used to. It's more of a chore now. But I'm still managing.
Do you often feel anxious or nervous when you're not thinking about forgetting something or checking things?
Um... no. Not really. I don't feel anxious, just... regular, I suppose. It's only when I'm worried about forgetting those specific things.
How long have you been experiencing these nagging thoughts and checking behaviors?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't exactly kept track of it. Just... a little while, I guess.
Do you generally feel anxious or on edge even when you're not worried about forgetting something?
Um... I think I just mentioned this, but... no. Not really. I just feel normal when I'm not thinking about all that. I'm not just on edge all the time.
Do you feel anxious when you're not thinking about anything in particular?
I... no. I don't. Like I said a minute ago, I just feel normal. I'm... I'm not sure what else to tell you, I just don't feel anxious otherwise.
Do you feel like you're often anxious for no reason at all, even when you're not thinking about anything in particular?
I... I feel like you're asking me the exact same thing again. No. I don't get anxious for no reason. I'm just... fine, otherwise.
Do you feel like you're anxious more often than other people, even when you're not thinking about forgetting something?
I... I really don't know how else to answer this. No. I don't think I'm more anxious than anyone else. Like I keep saying... if I'm not worried about my things, I'm fine. That's it.
Do you think you would feel anxious if you weren't having these worries about forgetting things?
I just... no. I wouldn't. I'd be fine. I really think I've answered this already.
Do you feel anxious most of the time, even when you're not thinking about specific things like forgetting something?
No. I... I really don't. Just... no. I don't have anything else to add to that.
